summary: Elevate your business skills with our Revenue Enhancement Training Course. Discover effective techniques to increase revenue and drive growth today.
lede: Revenue enhancement focuses on finding opportunities to improve pricing, sales performance and customer retention. Designed for finance and commercial professionals, the course covers value-based and dynamic pricing, pipeline velocity and churn analysis, and revenue audits to identify leakage. It also explores cross-functional revenue operations and automation for forecasting, lead nurturing and renewals.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for mid-to-senior level professionals responsible for the financial health and commercial trajectory of their organizations.
audience: Customer Success Leads focused on churn mitigation
modules: AI and Automation in Revenue Management
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3-5 years of experience in a commercial, financial, or sales leadership role. A basic understanding of financial statements (P&L) and experience using a CRM platform like Salesforce or HubSpot is required. No coding knowledge is necessary, but comfort with data analysis in Excel is highly recommended.
